Workshop on Cloud Computing Fundamentals

The Department of CSE is conducting a one-day hands-on workshop on cloud computing fundamentals, open to all 2nd and 3rd year students.

Registration opens: 14th October 2026
Last date to register: 18th October 2026, 5:00 PM
Workshop date: 21st October 2026
Time: 10:00 AM
Venue: Seminar Hall 2, CSE Block

The registration link will be shared on the department notice board on 14th October.
Limited to 60 seats.
